makevoid-motion-graphics-music-video-ski.description: Create and revise beat-synced motion-graphics music videos from a supplied song and creative prompt, drawn entirely with the bundled native Swift renderer (vector line art, type, Metal shaders, neon glow), with music mapping, researched storyboards, procedural Swift SFX and Swift VFX. Use for full music videos or revisions to their scenes, animation, sound and effects.
